auditMeta.scope: All backend files referencing JAVIER schema tables for repartidor liquidacion diaria, cobros, and comisiones features

JAVIER.REPARTIDOR_COBROS.notes: App-only cobros table; CVC is ERP vencimientos

JAVIER.REPARTIDOR_ENTREGAS.notes: App-only delivery tracking; OPP is ERP ordenes preparacion

JAVIER.REPARTIDOR_ENTREGA_LINEAS.notes: App-only line items; LAC is ERP lineas albaran

JAVIER.REPARTIDOR_FIRMAS.notes: App-only firmas; CACFIRMAS is ERP firmas

JAVIER.REPARTIDOR_OBJETIVOS.notes: App-only objetivos; CMV is ERP objetivos

JAVIER.DELIVERY_STATUS.notes: App-only delivery status; CPC is ERP conformado status

JAVIER.CLIENT_SIGNERS.notes: App-only signer cache; CLI is ERP clientes

JAVIER.REPARTIDOR_LIQUIDACION_OPS.notes: App-only ops ledger; maps to LQD

JAVIER.REPARTIDOR_FINANCIAL_BALANCES.notes: Derived from LQD+CVC; no direct DSEDAC equiv

JAVIER.REPARTIDOR_COMMISSION_TIERS.notes: Hardcoded in code; no DSEDAC equiv

JAVIER.REPARTIDOR_LIQUIDACION_EMAILS.notes: App-only email log; no DSEDAC equiv

JAVIER.COMMISSION_EXCEPTIONS.notes: App-only exclusion list; no DSEDAC equiv

JAVIER.COMMISSION_PAYMENTS.notes: App-only payment ledger; no DSEDAC equiv

phase1_configFile.description: Create a centralized schema/table mapping config file

phase2_schemaVariable.description: Replace hardcoded JAVIER. with configurable schema variable
phase2_schemaVariable.pattern: Already partially implemented in repartidor-finance-service.js with ERP_FINANCE_SCHEMA and LQD_TABLE
phase2_schemaVariable.action: Extend this pattern to ALL files
phase2_schemaVariable.example: const SCHEMA = process.env.ERP_SCHEMA || 'DSEDAC'; const APP_SCHEMA = process.env.APP_SCHEMA || 'JAVIER'; const TABLES = { COBROS: `${APP_SCHEMA}.REPARTIDOR_COBROS`, ... };

phase3_columnTranslation.description: Create column name mapping for app tables vs DSEDAC tables

actions: Already has ERP_FINANCE_SCHEMA pattern — extend to all tables
Replace all 38 JAVIER. references with TABLES.* constants
LQD_TABLE already uses variable pattern — replicate for all other tables
initCommissionTables() needs schema variable for CREATE TABLE statements
Note: RUTERO_CONFIG ORDEN >= 0 filter must be preserved
Replace JAVIER.DELIVERY_STATUS in startup probe (2 occurrences)
Use TABLES.DELIVERY_STATUS constant instead of hardcoded

keyInsights: repartidor-finance-service.js already has the LQD_TABLE variable pattern — use as template
App tables use snake_case (CODIGO_REPARTIDOR) vs DSEDAC concatenated (CODIGOREPARTIDOR)
DELIVERY_STATUS is the most referenced app table across 6 of 7 files
REPARTIDOR_COBROS is the second most referenced — 15+ queries across 3 files
RUTERO_CONFIG has the most WRITE operations (12) — all in planner.js
COMMISSION_* tables are app-only with no DSEDAC equivalent
Column name translation is the biggest refactoring challenge — 35+ column mappings needed
